function analyzeJoinExpressions(left, right, joinedSource, role) {
  const leftRefs = (0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.collectPropRefs)(left);
  const rightRefs = (0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.collectPropRefs)(right);
  const leftRoles = new Set(leftRefs.map(role));
  const rightRoles = new Set(rightRefs.map(role));
  const leftMain = leftRoles.has(`main`) || leftRoles.has(`ancestor`);
  const rightMain = rightRoles.has(`main`) || rightRoles.has(`ancestor`);
  const leftJoined = leftRoles.has(`joined`);
  const rightJoined = rightRoles.has(`joined`);
  if (leftMain && !leftJoined && rightJoined && !rightRoles.has(`main`)) {
    return { mainExpr: left, joinedExpr: right };
  };
  if (leftJoined && !leftRoles.has(`main`) && rightMain && !rightJoined) {
    return { mainExpr: right, joinedExpr: left };
  };
  if (leftRefs.length === 0 || rightRefs.length === 0) {
    throw new __vite_ssr_import_1__.InvalidJoinConditionSourceMismatchError();
  };
  if (leftRefs.length === 1 && rightRefs.length === 1 && (leftRefs[0].bindingId !== void 0 && rightRefs[0].bindingId !== void 0 ? leftRefs[0].bindingId === rightRefs[0].bindingId : getJoinRefAlias(leftRefs[0]) === getJoinRefAlias(rightRefs[0]))) {
    throw new __vite_ssr_import_1__.InvalidJoinConditionSameSourceError(
      getJoinRefAlias(leftRefs[0])
    );
  };
  if (!leftMain) {
    throw new __vite_ssr_import_1__.InvalidJoinConditionLeftSourceError(
      getJoinRefAlias(leftRefs[0])
    );
  };
  if (!rightJoined) {
    throw new __vite_ssr_import_1__.InvalidJoinConditionRightSourceError(joinedSource);
  };
  throw new __vite_ssr_import_1__.InvalidJoinCondition();
}

function encodeNonFiniteKey(_, value) {
  return typeof value === `number` && !Number.isFinite(value) ? { number: String(value) } : value;

function processJoinResults(joinedSource, mainAliases) {
  return (pipeline) => pipeline.pipe(
    (0,__vite_ssr_import_0__.map)((result) => {
      const [_key, [main, joined]] = result;
      const mainKey = main?.[0];
      const mainNamespacedRow = main?.[1];
      const joinedKey = joined?.[0];
      const joinedNamespacedRow = joined?.[1];
      const mergedNamespacedRow = Object.assign(
        {},
        mainNamespacedRow ?? joinedNamespacedRow
      );
      if (main == null) {
        for (const alias of mainAliases) delete mergedNamespacedRow[alias];
      };
      if (joinedNamespacedRow) {
        mergedNamespacedRow[joinedSource] = joinedNamespacedRow[joinedSource];
      } else {
        delete mergedNamespacedRow[joinedSource];
      };
      const resultKey = JSON.stringify(
        [mainKey ?? null, joinedKey ?? null],
        encodeNonFiniteKey
      );
      return [resultKey, mergedNamespacedRow];
    })
  );
}
function getActiveAndLazySources(joinType, leftCollection, rightCollection, mainSourceIsParentFiltered) {
  switch (joinType) {
    case `left`:
      return { activeSource: `main`, lazySource: rightCollection };
    case `right`:
      return { activeSource: `joined`, lazySource: leftCollection };
    case `inner`:
      if (mainSourceIsParentFiltered) {
        return { activeSource: `main`, lazySource: rightCollection };
      };
      return leftCollection.size < rightCollection.size ? { activeSource: `main`, lazySource: rightCollection } : { activeSource: `joined`, lazySource: leftCollection };
    default:
      return { activeSource: void 0, lazySource: void 0 };
  }
}
